ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.BypassValidations), NOT(TEXT( SBQQ__Quote__r.SBQQ__Status__c ) = "Draft"), NOT(TEXT( SBQQ__Quote__r.SBQQ__Status__c ) = "In Review") )
